checkpointPayload.description: Ensure Tower (floor 23 boss cleared), Dungeon (exhausted/unwinnable), Expeditions (done/waiting), Freebies, and Quests are never re-run when done, and prevent mergeActivityWithAutopilotState from forcing false DONE labels on pending cards
checkpointPayload.title: P1-21: Autopilot Skip Done/Unwinnable Activities & Accurate Card States

taskChanges.newValue: Implemented P1-21: towerActivityState checks all today entries for floor 23 boss clear, dungeonActivityState + DungeonModal mark exhausted/unwinnable floors done, isDailyActivityAlreadyDone covers all activities (including expeditions done/waiting, freebies, quests) in both startAutopilot and runSingleStep, and mergeActivityWithAutopilotState preserves done/pending card states accurately.
